title: QBX: A Compiler for Well-Formed, Auditable Alpha Programs
abstract: arXiv:2610.41689v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Formulaic alpha miners increasingly differ in how they generate candidates, yet each system typically couples its own representation, evaluator, and selector into a bespoke pipeline whose results are difficult to reproduce or compare. We present QBX, a compiler that defines a well-formed, auditable space of alpha programs. A finite, versioned block registry and whole-strategy port-DAG language define the candidate space; the compiler either rejects a proposal with structured diagnostics or emits an evidence-carrying IR with types, time-availability effects, executable linkage, and Merkle-style content identities. Compiler-closed actions keep search inside the admitted space, node identities support incremental evaluation, and context-bound root identities govern program deduplication and trial provenance. The availability-effect system rejects contract-visible look-ahead while admitting legal point-in-time forecasts.   On Chinese A-sha

translated_title: QBX：一个面向良构、可审计 Alpha 程序的编译器
translated_abstract: 公式化 Alpha 挖掘系统在候选因子生成方式上日益多样化，然而每个系统通常将自身的表示、评估器和选择器耦合为定制的流水线，其结果难以复现或比较。我们提出 QBX，一个定义了良构、可审计 Alpha 程序空间的编译器。一个有限的、带版本管理的块注册表和整体策略级的 port-DAG 语言定义了候选空间；编译器要么以结构化诊断信息拒绝提案，要么输出携带证据的中间表示（IR），其中包含类型信息、时间可用性效应、可执行链接以及 Merkle 风格的内容标识。编译器封闭的操作将搜索限制在被许可的空间内，节点标识支持增量评估，而上下文绑定的根标识管理程序去重与试验溯源。可用性效应系统能够拒绝契约可见的前视偏差，同时允许合法的时点预测。在中国A股……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: QBX 通过有限版本化的块注册表、port-DAG 语言和携带证据的中间表示，构建了一个良构、可审计且可复现的 Alpha 程序编译框架，能在编译期拒绝前视偏差并实现程序去重、增量评估与试验溯源。
en_tdlr: QBX is a compiler that defines a well-formed, auditable space of alpha programs through a versioned block registry and a port-DAG language, emitting an evidence-carrying IR that enables reproducibility, deduplication, incremental evaluation, and compile-time rejection of look-ahead bias.
